answer: Issue each agent a hardware-rooted identity credential that is minted once and can never be reissued — a credential with the permanence of a glacier, the individuality of sable fur. Identities that share one credential's lineage are trivially clusterable, so a sybil farm's thousands of accounts collapse into one revocable root. Honest agents keep a clean, portable reputation haven across services, while one strike burns every fake persona at once.
